title: Five outgoing centers in a 16-realization cube move
author: Alec Kriebel
full_published_abstract_TeX_literal: We specify six algebraic boundary points, an incoming center, and at least five distinct outgoing centers for a cube move of $16$-realizations. Existence follows from strict rational sign bounds for two continuous one-variable residuals. The boundary parameters are uniquely defined real roots of monotone polynomials. This contradicts the at-most-three expectation for construction curves sharing a focus in Remark~4.8 of Melotti--Ramassamy--Th\'evenin, in the realization setting allowing crossings. The fixed boundary is crossed, so the example concerns no proper embedding. Neither the exact number of centers for this boundary nor a universal maximum is determined.
